resource.title: The Art and Science of PCB Design（MIT IAP 课程 6.S092 / EC.S03，课程站点公开）
resource.covers: 从系统需求到量产的完整板级流程：系统设计与参数建模、SPICE 仿真、原理图绘制、器件选型与数据手册阅读、PCB 布局布线、EDA 工具（Altium / KiCad / LTspice）、板厂制造工艺（DFM）、以及手工贴装焊接；课程站点开放讲义、lab 与历年归档，非 MIT 学生也能看。供电完整性、信号完整性与 EMC 只在高级仿真与客座讲座里点到，不是主线。

courses.course: 6.S092 / EC.S03 The Art and Science of PCB Design
courses.prereq_text: Prerequisites: It is recommended to understand basic circuit analysis provided in 6.200, 2.678/2.679, or equivalent. This generally entails understanding how to analyze/implement resistors, inductors, capacitors, and operational amplifiers in an electrical circuit.

courses.school: University of California, Santa Cruz (Silicon Valley Extension)
courses.course: Printed Circuit Board Design for Signal Integrity and EMC Compliance
courses.prereq_text: Prior experience with printed circuit board and system level design and testing is highly desired. A solid foundation in basic electrical engineering principles helps one understand fundamental design concepts.

notes: 两门课都只把电路基础写成建议（MIT 原文 'It is recommended to understand basic circuit analysis ... 6.200'，UCSC 原文 'A solid foundation in basic electrical engineering principles helps ...'），没有列为必修，故 H.1.1 判 recommended。UCSC 那门是大学的职业延伸学院课程（收费，USD 580），不是学位课，但它是找到的唯一明确以信号完整性 + EMC 为主线的正式课程；MIT 的 IAP 课免费、讲义与 lab 全部公开，但供电/信号完整性部分较浅。PCB 课普遍不设硬性先修，这与节点简介里偏向工程实践的性质相符。
